input.quote: 14.2 Upon creation and subject to payment of the applicable Fees, Customer owns each Deliverable created specifically for Customer. Vendor hereby assigns to Customer all worldwide right, title, and interest in those Deliverables and shall obtain equivalent assignments from its personnel. Vendor will execute further documents reasonably needed to confirm ownership.
input.rationale: Section 14 meets our preferred position. 14.1 confirms Customer owns all Customer Data, Customer Confidential Information and pre-existing/independent IP, with no transfer to Vendor beyond a limited processing right (reinforced by 15.1's bar on sale, advertising, data combination and model training). 14.2 gives present-tense Customer ownership of Deliverables with a Vendor assignment plus personnel assignments and further-assurance covenant. 14.3 lets Vendor retain only Vendor Technology and routes any embedded Vendor Technology into the perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid licence in 13.2. 14.4 negates joint ownership absent a signed instrument and keeps feedback voluntary with Customer retaining unrestricted use. Nothing assigns Customer IP or data to Vendor. Two minor sub-points are noted, not flagged: ownership in 14.2 is "subject to payment of the applicable Fees" (a customary condition, mitigated by 10.1/10.2), and the 13.2 licence lists contractor support rather than an express sublicensing right, which is short of the ideal wording only.
